summary: Agentflow finality now emits one response done at every successful graph boundary, including empty-output graphs, and preserves complete final text by accumulating forwarded response deltas.
Model provider errors, interrupted or cancelled completions, and tool follow-up failures clear the active response context inline so late completions are rejected as stale.
Tool follow-up validation, request build, missing stream, and send failures now emit LLMErrorPacket for the existing context instead of only logging.

corrections.finding: agentflow final done was gated on nonempty output
corrections.resolution: emitResponseDone now emits after successful graph boundaries unless the context is cancelled or failed, so empty successful output closes.

corrections.finding: agentflow final text overwrote previous node output
corrections.resolution: responseFinalityCommunication accumulates LLMResponseDeltaPacket text for the active context and suppresses inner done packets, preserving one final done snapshot.
provider errors clear currentPacket inline before emitting LLMErrorPacket, so later successful done for the same request is stale.
tool follow-up failures clear currentPacket inline and emit LLMErrorPacket with the affected context ID.

corrections.finding: active-context checks could race with interruption or a new response
corrections.resolution: completion handling rechecks the active context before mutating history, before executing tool calls, and before emitting final done.

residual_issues: No residual critical or major issues are known inside the producer correction scope.
Existing dirty edits outside this correction scope were preserved and not reviewed.
